第89章 看风水3-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

刘家的祖坟，都在离家不远的一座小山上——说是山，其实也就算是一片大一点的土丘，路况崎岖，车子根本开不过去，一行人只能徒步往山上走。

土丘上的坟茔很多，可就在众人走到刘航爷爷的坟前时，赵安坤立马立马看出了不对劲的地方。

刚想开口，就听见身旁的吴启明先一步开口了。

“不对劲，这里有问题。”

赵安坤轻咦了一声，眼里满是诧异：“老爷子，您也懂风水之术？”

老爷子故作高深的轻点了一下头，摸了摸没有胡子的下巴。

“略懂一二罢了，最近一直在研究易经，郭璞的葬经，也粗略看了一点。”说完，又伸手指向坟头，“你们看，坟头上的那几棵小树苗。”

赵安坤瞬间肃然起敬，这是高手啊！

一旁的吴姜在心里偷着乐，老爷子研究易经的事情他知道，前后也就看了半个多月，顶多算是个半桶水的水平，没想到居然把赵安坤这都给唬住了。

赵安坤拿出罗盘，走到坟前，仔细勘察起来，又环顾了一下四周的地势，这才缓缓点头，对着众人说道：

“老爷子说的没错，问题就出在这几棵树苗上。这是桃树，桃树属阳木，阳气极重，而坟地是阴地，阳木长在阴地，阴阳相悖，煞气郁结，不出问题才怪！”

刘父闻言，忍不住狠狠拍了下大腿，一脸懊悔地说道：“哎呦喂！这居然是桃树？过年上坟的时候我就看到这些小树苗了，还以为是普通的野草，压根没当回事！吴师傅，赵师傅，你们快说说，现在该怎么处理啊？”

在农村，坟地长出些杂草树木，属实是太正常不过了，一般人还真不一定能认出这是什么树的树苗。

一旁的吴姜差点没忍住笑出声来，老爷子这就混成师傅了，看他等会儿怎么圆场，能不能说出个子丑寅卯来。

吴启明却是淡然的笑了笑，摆了摆手，谦虚地说道：“还是让赵师傅来说吧，我的水平有限，懂得不多，就不在这里献丑了。”

众人听了，都以为老爷子是太过谦虚，能一眼就看出坟头的问题，怎么可能没有解决的办法？一个个看向老爷子的眼神，又多了几分敬佩。

赵安坤先朝着老爷子点了点头，随后才接过话茬：“只要找到问题根源，解决起来就容易了。”

Chapter 89 Looking at Feng Shui 3-"The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of God"

The ancestral graves of the Liu family are all on a hill not far from their home - it is said to be a mountain, but in fact it is just a larger mound. The road is rugged and cars cannot drive over it, so the group can only walk up the mountain.

There were many tombs on the mound, but when everyone walked to Grandpa Liu Hang's grave, Zhao Ankun immediately saw something was wrong.

Just as he was about to speak, he heard Wu Qiming beside him speak first.

"Something's wrong, there's something wrong here."

Zhao Ankun let out a light sigh, his eyes full of surprise: "Old man, do you also know the art of Feng Shui?"

The old man nodded his head pretending to be profound and touched his beardless chin.

"I only know a little bit about it. I have been studying the Book of Changes recently, and I also briefly read Guo Pu's Burial Scripture." After saying that, he pointed to the tomb again, "Look at the saplings on the tomb."

Zhao Ankun was immediately in awe, this is a master!

Wu Jiang on the side was secretly amused. He knew about the old man's study of the Book of Changes. He had only studied it for more than half a month, and it was at least half a bucket of water. He didn't expect that he actually frightened Zhao Ankun.

Zhao Ankun took out his compass, walked to the tomb, carefully surveyed it, and then looked around at the terrain, then nodded slowly and said to everyone:

"The old man is right. The problem lies with these saplings. These are peach trees. Peach trees are Yang trees and have extremely strong Yang energy. The cemetery is a Yin place. Yang trees grow in Yin places. Yin and Yang are in conflict with each other and the evil energy is trapped. It would be strange if there is no problem!"

Hearing this, Father Liu couldn't help but slap his thigh hard, and said with a regretful look on his face: "Ouch! This is actually a peach tree? I saw these saplings when I visited the grave during the Chinese New Year. I thought they were ordinary weeds and didn't take them seriously at all! Master Wu, Master Zhao, please tell me, what should we do now?"

In rural areas, it is quite normal for some weeds and trees to grow in cemeteries. Most people may not be able to recognize the saplings of these trees.

Wu Jiang on the side almost couldn't help but laugh out loud. The old man has become a master now. Let's see how he smoothes things over later and whether he can reveal his ugly appearance.

Wu Qiming smiled indifferently, waved his hand, and said humbly: "Let Master Zhao speak. My level is limited and I don't know much, so I won't show my shame here."

After everyone heard this, they all thought that the old man was too humble. He could see the problem of the grave at a glance. How could there be no solution?Everyone looked at the old man with a little more admiration.

Zhao Ankun nodded towards the old man first, and then took over the conversation: "As long as we find the source of the problem, it will be easy to solve it."
